diagnosed_change_only.from: compare complete raw exports whose uv command comments contain distinct output paths
diagnosed_change_only.to: validate and remove exactly the first two uv autogenerated header lines, then compare and retain every remaining dependency-body byte
diagnosed_change_only.unchanged: source revision, uv.lock, uv and Python binaries, export flags, two-pass design, offline policy, requirements semantics, resources, and scientific roles

normalization_contract.line_1_exact: # This file was autogenerated by uv via the following command:

exporters.role: unchanged frozen identities and export command
recovery normalization, comparison, canonical retention, and evidence

acceptance: All source, lock, uv, and Python identities match and the source is clean.
Both raw exports succeed under the unchanged frozen offline flags.
Each raw export has exactly the validated two-line uv header followed by a non-empty body.
The normalized bodies are byte-identical, exactly 256006 bytes, and SHA-256 6f0836431e1a0ba74bdc92732ffb0a81a1c72691bdab2bc3fba43c4a1e3716c6.
The canonical body contains exactly 208 requirement heads, required runtime packages, and no local workspace reference.
uv.lock remains unchanged, source remains clean, and the recovery root is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED without TERMINAL_REJECTED.
failure: Any collision, identity change, header mismatch, body mismatch, expected hash/count mismatch, source mutation, local path leak, command failure, or timeout seals recovery1 as TERMINAL_REJECTED and preserves all outputs.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit the canonical requirements file, then freeze its wheelhouse acquisition. Export acceptance does not authorize downloading wheels, installing packages, or acquiring models.
prohibited_actions: editing or deleting the v1 rejected export evidence
normalizing or deleting any dependency-body byte
changing uv.lock, source, uv, Python, export flags, versions, ordering, markers, URLs, or hashes
installing dependencies, downloading models, or starting pg0/service/lifecycle/numerical work
populating any comparison-table numeric cell from this stage
